role: Offline-run generator (not in CI) that downloads 20 nsr2db records from PhysioNet, extracts a 300-interval window per record, computes reference time-domain HRV metrics in Python and writes EmuquTests/HRVReferenceFixtures.swift (consumed by HRVReferenceValidationTests).
toplevel: Module constants: BASE URL, RECORDS nsr001..nsr020, 128 Hz, WINDOW_BEATS 300, SKIP_BEATS 5000, WFDB codes, BEAT_CODES set. `if __name__ == '__main__': raise SystemExit(main())`.

units.does: Decodes a WFDB annotation blob into absolute sample offsets of beat annotations: 16-bit LE words, code = top 6 bits, delta = low 10; handles SKIP (32-bit delta), NUM/SUB/CHN (no time advance), AUX (skip padded text).

branches.effect: read signed-high/unsigned-low 32-bit delta, add to t, continue
skip delta bytes rounded up to even, continue
append t after adding delta; non-beat codes advance time only

units.does: Computes meanRR, sample SDNN (N-1), unfiltered RMSSD, unfiltered pNN50 (>50 ms) and 60000/meanRR from an RR list, each rounded to 6 decimals.
HTTP GET of BASE/name+suffix with 60 s timeout; returns bytes (exceptions propagate).

For each record: fetches .hea (parses Age:/Sex:), fetches .ecg annotations, decodes beats, skips records with too few beats or any window interval outside 300-2000 ms, rounds intervals to integer ms, and returns records with sha256 of the raw file, rrMs and Python-computed expected metrics.

branches.effect: parse tokens for Age:/Sex: values; else ignored (age/sex stay None)
stderr note, record skipped; else appended

units.does: Renders the records as compact JSON wrapped at 110 chars inside a Swift `enum HRVReferenceFixtures { static let json = """...""" }` with provenance/licence header.
CLI: builds records; with --check compares the generated source to the committed file and returns 1 on missing/different; otherwise writes the file. Returns 1 if no usable record.
